title: DNA extraction from wheat leaf tissue
author: Benjamin Schwessinger
materials: The demonstrator will freeze your sample on dry ice. The demonstrator will rupture your tissue using a TissueLyzer II https://www.qiagen.com/us/products/human-id-and-forensics/automation/tissuelyser-ii at 25 Hz for 1 min. Now the leaf rupture part of the protocol is complete.
Discard the DNeasy Mini spin column.

steps.title: Label bead tubes
steps.instruction: Label each 2 ml Eppendorf tube that contains 2–3 steel beads with the treatment‑group name and your research‑group name on both the top and the side.

steps.title: Select and cut leaf pieces
steps.instruction: Inspect plants, choose two leaves per treatment group that show the representative symptoms (or no symptoms for the negative control). Cut a 1.5–2 cm middle segment from each leaf, combine the two pieces into the correctly labelled tube and place the tube on ice.

steps.title: Label extraction tubes and columns
steps.instruction: For each treatment group label the following set of tubes and spin columns with the group and research‑group name: a QIAshredder spin column (pink) in a 2 ml collection tube, an extra 2 ml collection tube, two 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes, and a DNeasy Mini spin column (blue) in a 2 ml collection tube. Prepare five identical sets.

steps.title: Add Buffer AP1 and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 400 µl Buffer AP1 to each 2 ml tube containing the ruptured leaf tissue on ice and vortex until the tissue is completely resuspended.

steps.title: Add RNase A and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 4 µl RNase A to each tube, vortex again to mix.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes for 10 min at 65 °C in a water bath or heating block, inverting the tubes 2–3 times during the incubation.

steps.title: Brief hand centrifugation
steps.instruction: Briefly spin each tube in a hand‑centrifuge as demonstrated by the demonstrator to collect the lysate at the bottom.

steps.title: Add Buffer P3 and mix
steps.instruction: Add 130 µl Buffer P3 to each tube and mix by inverting 10–20 times immediately after addition.

steps.title: Second hand centrifugation
steps.instruction: Briefly spin each tube again in a hand‑centrifuge as demonstrated.

steps.title: Ice incubation
steps.instruction: Cool the tubes on ice for 2 min, then incubate on ice for an additional 5 min (longer incubation does not affect outcome).

steps.title: Clear lysate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysates for 5 min at maximum speed to pellet large undissolved particles.

substeps.instruction: Label tubes with group and TG name before loading.
Balance the centrifuge rotor before starting.

steps.title: Pass lysate through QIAshredder
steps.instruction: Pipette 480 µl of the cleared lysate into a QIAshredder spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube, taking care not to disturb any pellet.

steps.title: Centrifuge QIAshredder flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the QIAshredder assembly for 2 min at maximum speed and keep the flow‑through in the lower collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Label tubes and balance the centrifuge as above.

steps.title: Transfer flow‑through to new tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µl of the flow‑through to a newly labelled 1.5 ml tube, avoiding any pellet.

steps.title: Add Buffer AW1 and mix
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl Buffer AW1 to the 1.5 ml tube and mix by pipetting.

steps.title: Bind DNA to DNeasy column
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µl of the mixture to a DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2 (first)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 1 min at maximum speed, discard the flow‑through, then place the spin column in a new 2 ml collection tube and add 500 µl Buffer AW2 on top without touching the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Label tubes and balance the centrifuge before each spin.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2 (second)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed, discard the flow‑through, tap the collection tube on a paper towel to remove residual liquid, place the column back in the same 2 ml tube and add another 500 µl Buffer AW2.

substeps.instruction: Label tubes and balance the centrifuge before each spin.

steps.title: Final spin to dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 min at maximum speed, discard the flow‑through, tap the tube on a paper towel to remove remaining liquid, then place the column back in the same 2 ml tube and centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed.

substeps.instruction: Label tubes and balance the centrifuge before each spin.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer AE (first)
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new labelled 1.5 ml tube, add 75 µl Buffer AE to the centre of the membrane, incubate 5 min at room temperature (15–25 °C), then centrifuge 1 min at maximum speed.

substeps.instruction: Label tubes and balance the centrifuge before the spin.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer AE (second)
steps.instruction: Add another 75 µl Buffer AE to the centre of the membrane, incubate 5 min at room temperature (15–25 °C), and centrifuge 1 min at maximum speed.

substeps.instruction: Label tubes and balance the centrifuge before the spin.

steps.title: Store and hand over DNA
steps.instruction: Close the collection tubes; each now contains ~150 µl DNA in elution buffer. Hand over the five clearly labelled tubes to the demonstrator for storage until next week.
